incidents.title: AdGuard Home sends its credentials in clear text
incidents.summary: AdGuard Home sends its credentials over plain http:// to 10.20.30.3. Anyone on the network path can read the admin password, and every AdGuard Home user is an administrator. Use https:// if it supports it.
incidents.resolves_when: Resolves when the instance's URL uses https://.

incidents.title: magpie's socket proxy is too broad
incidents.summary: The socket proxy at tcp://10.20.30.20:2375 lets every GET under /containers/ through, so anyone who can reach it can read every container's environment, logs and files. Restrict who can connect (a firewall, or wollomatic's -allowfrom), or switch to a path-anchored allowlist like Cha Dash's compose preset.
incidents.resolves_when: Resolves when the proxy refuses container logs.

incidents.title: Frigate grants admin without a sign-in
incidents.summary: Cha Dash reads Frigate through a Frigate port (55000), which answers without a sign-in and makes anyone who can reach it an admin: they can change the config, restart Frigate and delete recordings.

suggested.label: Use the authenticated port
suggested.detail: Create a Frigate user with the viewer role, then point this instance at Frigate's authenticated port (8971) with that user.

incidents.resolves_when: Resolves when Cha Dash signs in to Frigate.

incidents.title: Traefik's dashboard has no auth
incidents.summary: Traefik's dashboard is routed without an auth middleware on traefik.home.example. Its API asked for credentials, so only the dashboard's page is open today, but one router change could expose the API, and with it basic-auth password hashes.
incidents.resolves_when: Resolves when every dashboard router has an auth middleware.

incidents.title: Backups on wren couldn't reach pbs-magpie
incidents.summary: wren's daily 02:00 backup couldn't reach its storage pbs-magpie (10.20.30.20:8007) on its Oct 3 02:00 run (No route to host), so nothing was backed up. It failed 1 of the last 4 runs. The last good run ended Oct 2 02:05.

facts.error: could not activate storage 'pbs-magpie': pbs-magpie: error fetching datastores - 500 Can't connect to 10.20.30.20:8007 (No route to host)

causes.text: It writes to PBS datastore main on Proxmox Backup Server, which has a problem of its own: PBS datastore is filling up.
Backups on aviary to the same PBS failed too: Backup of homeassistant failed.
Backups on owl to the same PBS failed too: Backup of win-games failed.
pbs-magpie (10.20.30.20:8007) didn't answer at 02:00 (No route to host). Other hosts that back up to it fail on the same nights.

suggested.label: Open the backup jobs in Proxmox

incidents.resolves_when: Resolves when a run of this job succeeds: a retry, or the next scheduled run.

incidents.title: PBS datastore is filling up
incidents.summary: Datastore main is 92% full (1.84 of 2 TB). At this rate it fills up in about 3 weeks.

causes.text: The daily prune job has been disabled since 14 Sep, so 38 snapshots are outside the retention policy.
studio's backup at 02:30 wrote 108 GB of new data, about 12 times a usual night. It has been running since yesterday 21:15.

suggested.label: Prune per policy
suggested.detail: Removes the 38 snapshots outside keep-daily 7 · weekly 4 · monthly 6, then runs garbage collection (about 20 minutes). Frees about 116 GB (92% → 86%). Pruned snapshots can't be restored.

alternatives.label: Re-enable the daily prune job
alternatives.detail: Prunes every night at 03:30 from now on. Undo turns it off again.

incidents.title: Nextcloud is stuck in maintenance mode
incidents.summary: Nextcloud has answered 503 Service Unavailable since 07:10. The update to 32.0.1 finished at 07:12, but maintenance mode stayed on, so nobody can open their files.

causes.text: nextcloud was recreated with image nextcloud:32.0.1 at 07:10, and the upgrade left maintenance mode on.
Nextcloud's HTTP check answers 503 while maintenance mode is on.

suggested.label: Turn off maintenance mode
suggested.detail: Runs occ maintenance:mode --off in the nextcloud container, about 30 seconds. Undo turns it back on.

incidents.resolves_when: Resolves when Nextcloud answers normally again.

incidents.title: Karakeep's API changed
incidents.summary: Karakeep was updated to 0.31.0 at 09:02, and its stats endpoint now returns 404. Karakeep itself is up; bookmark counts show values as of 09:05.

causes.text: karakeep-web-1 was recreated with image 0.31.0 at 09:02.
This integration supports Karakeep up to 0.30.

suggested.label: Update the Karakeep integration
suggested.detail: Switches to the adapter for 0.31. Undo puts the previous one back.

alternatives.label: Roll Karakeep back to 0.30.2
alternatives.detail: Redeploys the karakeep stack on rook with the previous image.

incidents.resolves_when: Resolves when the integration can read Karakeep again.

incidents.title: Internet downloads are slow
incidents.summary: Speed tests since 09:40 measure about 180 Mb/s down, against the usual 930. Upload and ping are normal. OPNsense's WAN hasn't gone above that since 09:40 either.

causes.text: Every speed test since 09:40 measured about 180 Mb/s down. The one at 09:10 measured about 930.
OPNsense's WAN tops out at the same speed, so the limit is outside the home: most likely the internet provider.

incidents.resolves_when: Resolves when a speed test measures the usual speed again.

incidents.title: Plex rejected its token
incidents.summary: Plex has answered 401 Unauthorized since 13:27. Plex itself is up; its tiles show values as of 13:27.

causes.text: The stored token stopped working at 13:27. It was probably revoked, by signing out all devices or changing the Plex password.
Plex's own HTTP check still passes, so the problem is the connection, not Plex.

suggested.label: Reconnect Plex
suggested.detail: Sign in with a Plex PIN, about 10 seconds. The new token goes into the vault.

incidents.title: stork is running out of memory
incidents.summary: Memory is at 95% of 8 GB and there is no swap. If it fills up, the kernel will stop a process to free memory.

causes.text: files (LXC 220) grew from 0.5 GB to 3.1 GB since 11:40.
No swap is configured on stork.

suggested.label: Restart files
suggested.detail: Restarts the LXC, which takes about 20 seconds. Cockpit and the Samba shares it serves are unavailable meanwhile.

incidents.resolves_when: Resolves when memory stays below 85% for 10 minutes.

incidents.title: qBittorrent ran out of memory
incidents.summary: Restarted at 14:03, waiting for the VPN tunnel. Sonarr and Radarr can't download until it's back.

causes.text: Memory grew from 1.1 GiB to the 4 GiB limit in 25 minutes.
About 20 torrents were downloading at the time.

suggested.label: Raise the memory limit to 6 GiB
suggested.detail: Unraid recreates qbittorrent with the new limit, about 2 minutes. Downloads pause meanwhile.

incidents.resolves_when: Resolves when the memory limit is raised, or after 24 hours without another OOM kill.
